rule_0.statement: A 2-DOF analytic closure (law-of-cosines IK, deterministic, branch picked at the settle) holds each forelimb paw at its PLANTED WORLD POSITION against the moving body -- the fore strut is a position-held strut, not a fixed-angle strut; with the paws planted, the front cannot sag and the hind positional-correction budget does not exhaust.
rule_0.prediction: Forepaw gaps (all four fore contact points) stay within the 1e-5 touch band for every tick through tick 426 (two full cycles -- the region where wave 11 lifted and refused at 291); the walk exceeds tick 426 at s=0.45; F-G1/F-G2/F-G3 become MEASURED for the first time; the wave-11 ledger peak (30.202201 J) collapses with the correction storm; the bisect is monotone in s.

design.ik: Planar 2-DOF closed form: paw reference = midpoint of the forearm's heel/MP paw points (local (0.031,-0.132753), rho=0.136324, beta=-1.341391); L1=0.125 from the elbow joint mount; shoulder world position evaluated each tick from the pelvis transform; law-of-cosines theta1 = delta +/- acos((D^2+L1^2-rho^2)/(2 D L1)), elbow from the closed vector solution q2 = theta2 - q1 - beta; branch (+/-1) captured ONCE at the end of the settle window as the branch closer to the planted configuration, then held. Out-of-reach targets saturate D to the reachable boundary (loud [ik] trace + saturation tick counters in status), never silently vanish.
design.capture: The paw target is the planted spot captured at the END of the 60-tick settle window (post poscorr, pre clock release), held fixed in the world (model) frame. Capture requires power+gait_enabled+contact; reset() clears it.
design.fore_share: New recipe field fore_share (default 0.45), quad-share envelope 0.25<=s<=0.55, bisect at {0.25,0.45,0.55}. The strut's static load line scales through the measured s=0.45 point: shoulder cap 4.229*(s/0.45) N.m and store floor 15x cap; the elbow keeps the doc-derived 3.76 N.m as an absolute CEILING (cap_elbow = 3.76*min(s,0.45)/0.45, floor 15x cap) -- the wave-11 falsifier forbids raising it, and the constructor now enforces cap_elbow<=3.76 in code.

honest_summary: The 2-DOF analytic closure itself is exact (1e-16 m FK round-trip; a world-frame formulation was falsified and replaced by the pelvis-frame law the same day), but the membrane is FALSIFIED at every measured share: the body out-walks the world-fixed paw plants (reach annulus hit at ticks 114/122; 176/291 ticks saturated; paw error 0.314 m), the paw-band falsifier is red (max gap 4.22e-2 m, first breach in the settle transient at tick 0), and the walk refuses at tick 291 -- the same tick, budget, and failing joint as wave 11 -- far short of the predicted 426. F-G1/F-G2/F-G3 remain unmeasured. The bisect is FLAT in fore_share (291/291/291; s=0.55 bit-identical to s=0.45): load share does not modulate this failure -- reach does. The 300-tick diagnostic banks the wave-11 ledger question: the 30.2 J PERSISTS (30.78 J here) and is brake/damping/friction heat of the toppling fall, not positional-correction work (0.23 J total). F-G5 (-9.806650 exactly), F-G7 (bit-identical), and the 19 graph tests stay green. Next membrane: the fore struts must STEP (a fore clock replanting ahead of the walking shoulder) or the planted-spot law must yield reach to the stride -- a fixed world plant cannot survive a translating body.
